label: risky
summary: A third-party deploy action that receives a production secret is moved from a commit SHA to the mutable main branch.

findings.title: Third-party action pinned to a mutable branch
findings.description: The deploy workflow now runs example-org/deploy-to-cloud@main. Anyone who can push to that repository's main branch can change the code that runs in this job, and the job passes the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret to the action.
findings.recommendation: Pin the action to a full commit SHA (with a version comment) and update it through reviewed dependency bumps.

evidence.observation: Action reference changed from a commit SHA to the 'main' branch.
The action receives the DEPLOY_TOKEN secret as an input.
